title: Read the obligation and its explanation
statement: As a product manager, I can read a concise criterion title, its full pass/fail statement and authored context so I can judge the intended outcome without reconstructing it from metadata.
overview:
The title helps readers scan; the statement remains the complete observable obligation. An optional Markdown overview explains rationale, examples and boundaries. Feature and story essays place those obligations in a readable product narrative.

Omitting prose on revision preserves it, while explicitly clearing the title or overview removes that prose. A changed explanation can alter an obligation, so related evidence must be reassessed. This records the merged behavior as a proposal rather than claiming product approval.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The criterion page displays the full statement even when a short authored title is present.
acceptance_criteria.title: Preserve the obligation
acceptance_criteria.overview: A short navigation label must never replace or truncate the obligation a reviewer needs to assess.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The criterion page renders its authored Markdown explanation under the product reading surface's content restrictions.
acceptance_criteria.title: Readable authored context
acceptance_criteria.overview: Authored prose is content, not executable page behavior. The merged safe-rendering tests exercise this distinction.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Revising one criterion preserves its omitted title and overview and leaves unrelated criteria unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.title: Preserve omitted prose
acceptance_criteria.overview: An explicit empty title or overview clears that field; omission is not a request to erase it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Changing a criterion title or overview makes evidence pinned to the older criterion content require reassessment.
acceptance_criteria.title: Reassess changed context
acceptance_criteria.overview: The same content contributes to the whole-story obligation, so a story-level relation cannot claim currency solely because the one-line statement stayed the same.
